A procedure for initiating a protected data interchange pathway across an interconnected computational fabric, said procedure comprising:
(a) Establishing an operational configuration for a secure information processing domain through the generation of a secure communication mechanism instance having parameters defining a threshold specification identifier for the communication regimen, and incorporating thereto one or more validation data units originating from a credentialing entity;
(b) mutually ascertaining cryptographic configuration elements between a client apparatus and a server apparatus,
wherein the negotiation entails identifying a cryptographic parameter set among a plurality of permissible cryptographic parameter sets, in dependence upon a specified threshold for a cryptographic key dimension;
(c) effectuating a reciprocal negotiation procedure between the initiating apparatus and the remote computational entity to determine transient cryptographic parameters;
(d) validating a sequence of digital credentials furnished by the remote computational entity, wherein said validating comprises:
(i)   ascertaining that a network designation of the host apparatus corresponds to a principal subject identifier or an ancillary subject identifier documented within a server credential;
(ii)  ascertaining that the cryptographic credential associated with the server continues within its period of designated validity;
(iii) verifying that provisions indicating permissible cryptographic functions present within the server credential authorize the attestation of the server's identity;
(e) conveying operational information via a confidential communication path, employing the pre-negotiated cryptographic parameters,
wherein the entirety of information conveyed between the consumer apparatus and the host apparatus undergoes cryptographic transformation by means of the cryptosystem specification established through mutual accord.
